title: Full-bleed photo hero
summary: The page's opening statement over one strong photo: eyebrow, title, a short lede and up to two actions. Use for a home page with a photo that carries the place. Avoid when no business-own or licensed photo exists (use a text hero instead).
a11y: Renders the page's only h1; the photo is decorative (alt="") because the copy states what matters.
Copy sits on a scrim anchored to the text, measured by the photo-contrast method at every device class.
A video variant pauses under prefers-reduced-motion and has a visible pause button.
truth: Never a photo of another business, and never a stock photo presented as this place.
The founding year and any claim in the eyebrow come from the business's own records.
